subject: Incident offset and commutation request — Novus Analytics impact window
messages:
From: Alicia Morales <alicia.morales@novus.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@novus.ai>, support@novus.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Production impact 2026-11-01 02:30-04:15 UTC — request for remediation credit

Hi Dylan,

We experienced an extended slowdown across our inference traffic during the 02:30–04:15 UTC window on 2026-11-01. Error rates spiked to ~3.2% and median p99 latency moved from ~310ms to ~1.2s for a subset of our high-concurrency endpoints. This impacted our checkout and recommendation jobs — we saw ~6% revenue-at-risk during that window.

We've attached the incident logs and our usage export for October. Per our contract (99.9% uptime SLA), we'd like to open a request for remediation/offsets and understand what one-off credits or term extensions Redwood will consider. Please let us know the proposed commutation and any remediation commitments (timeline & safeguards).

Appreciate a prompt response — our executive sponsor is requesting a letter of remediation and a commercial gesture.

Thanks,
Alicia Morales
Head of Platform Reliability
Novus Analytics
Attachments: incident_log_novus_20261101.zip, novus_usage_oct2026.csv

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Morales <alicia.morales@novus.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@novus.ai>, support@novus.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Production impact 2026-11-01 02:30-04:15 UTC — request for remediation credit

Alicia — thanks for the detailed packet and for flagging the revenue exposure. I’m very sorry for the disruption.

Short version: we will offer a one-time commutation credit for the impact window and a short-term operational offset while our remediation work completes. To move quickly I’m opening an internal approval request for a commercial remediation package and will loop in our Ops and Commercial leadership.

Next steps from us:
- We’ll run a root-cause summary (ETA 48 hours) and share mitigation steps.
- I’ll propose a commutation structure for review (credit amount + optional free month of Dedicated capacity).
- If Novus prefers a term extension in lieu of credit we can include that in the options.

I’ve attached our internal incident tracker link below and will follow up once I have approvals.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Related link: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/remediation/novus-20261101

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:27:00-08:00
Subject: Exec approval request — proposed commutation for Novus Analytics (impact window 02:30–04:15 UTC)

Team — forwarding the Novus packet and my recommended commercial remediation. This is time-sensitive — Novus has asked for an exec-level gesture and an SLA remediation letter. Below is the proposal and rationale.

Summary of impact (customer):
- P99 latency spike to ~1.2s for a subset of endpoints; error-rate increase to ~3.2% during a 1h45m window.
- Customer reports ~6% revenue-at-risk tied to delayed recommendations/checkout flow.
- Contract: 99.9% uptime SLA (hosted API plan, monthly billing).

Proposed makewhole/commutation options (choose 1):
A) Fixed credit: one-time $42,500 invoice credit applied to next billing cycle + 1 month free of Dedicated capacity (if Novus wants to trial Dedicated to stabilize peak traffic).
B) Term extension: waive next billing month (equivalent to ~25% of monthly committed spend) + priority remediation support (2-week runway).
C) Smaller credit + engineering commitment: $25,000 credit + guaranteed patch delivery plan and 90-day performance review.

My recommendation: Option A. Rationale: matches customer impact, signals seriousness, and the Dedicated month offers upsell runway if the migration reduces latency variance. Estimated commercial cost: ~$42.5k (one-time).

Ask: need exec approval or direction by COB 2026-11-04 so we can respond to the customer and include signoff language in the remediation letter. If approved, I’ll draft an amendment and produce a simple acceptance form for their signature.

Attachments: proposed_commutation_sheet_novus.xlsx, incident_log_novus_20261101.zip

Thanks — Dylan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — proposed commutation for Novus Analytics (impact window 02:30–04:15 UTC)

Dylan / team — reviewed. Thank you for the clear breakdown and the options. I approve a negotiated resolution but would like to limit one-time exposure and ensure we have remediation commitments in the doc. My approval:

Approved commercial package (counter-offer to customer):
- One-time invoice credit of $30,000 applied to the next cycle.
- One complimentary month of Dedicated capacity for stabilization (marketing/ops trial).
- A remediation SLA addendum: remediation summary within 48 hours, permanent mitigations roadmap with milestones (30/60/90 days), and a joint postmortem review.

Conditions:
- Customer signs an acceptance form acknowledging the package and the remediation timeline.
- We reserve the right to re-evaluate if additional impact is identified in the logs (i.e., rolling incidents).

Dylan — please draft the commercial acceptance and the short remediation addendum. Send to Legal for expedited review (cc me). If Novus pushes for Option A’s full $42.5k, escalate to me with customer exec context and revenue-at-risk math.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
